_comment: Which <label>.<apps domain> hosts are apps (ADR-1343). Mirrors pkg/api/app_slug.go: slug_pattern is appSlugRE, invalid_prefixes are rejected by ValidAppSlug, reserved_slugs is reservedAppSlugs; pkg/api/app_hosts_worker_test.go keeps them equal. platform_labels are platform hostnames that are never apps here but are not reserved app names; s3, origin and app-edge (this Worker's origin hostnames) became reserved slugs in ADR-20261026100000. An app holding one of those names is served by the control plane.
